items.subject: The Colonial mine tailings dump, a vast pale blue-grey heap on red Pilbara earth
items.action: Recent rain runoff carries loose tailings downslope in thin braided rivulets into a dry creek
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction follows the runoff from the heap toward the creek line
items.setting: Abandoned Colonial mine area beside Wittenoom Gorge, red ironstone hills, spinifex
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, dusty grey, streaks of muted blue, pale washed sky
items.props_detail: A fan of wet blue-grey sediment spreading at the foot of the heap
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.lighting: soft overcast dawn light after rain
items.mood: Still, damp air, low cloud, water quietly moving where no one stands
items.narration_anchor: Los relaves del vertedero de Colonial se van con el agua.

items.subject: Erosion gullies cutting from the tailings dump toward the creek, a lone environmental field observer seen from behind
items.action: The observer stands at a gully edge, the eroded channel marking the route the fibres take downhill
items.gaze_interaction: Observer faces away from camera, looking down the gully toward the distant creek
items.setting: Eroded slope below the Colonial dump, red rock and scattered spinifex
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, grey silt, faint blue fibre streaks, pale sky
items.props_detail: A deep fresh rill gouged through blue-grey sediment
items.lighting: soft overcast dawn light after rain
items.mood: Small figure dwarfed by eroded ground, damp stillness, flat grey light
items.narration_anchor: Un informe técnico lo marcó como la fuente principal y la vía del asbesto:

items.subject: A network of creek beds, rock pools and floodplains winding toward the Fortescue River
items.action: Shallow water threads through the creek system and spreads across the flat floodplain
items.gaze_interaction: Focal line runs from the gorge mouth out to the distant river
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge outflow and Fortescue floodplain, red ranges on the horizon
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre banks, green-grey river gums, silver water, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A pale blue-grey sediment film tracing the edges of every channel
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.mood: Calm vast land, quiet water, a slow spreading silence
items.narration_anchor: la erosión, los lechos de arroyo, las pozas, las llanuras de inundación hacia el río Fortescue.

items.subject: A drying creek bed where the receding water has left blue fibres behind
items.action: The last puddle evaporates, leaving a crust of fibres along its former rim
items.gaze_interaction: Focal point on the dried waterline ring on cracked mud
items.setting: Dry creek channel below Wittenoom Gorge, cracked red mud and pebbles
items.color_palette: Cracked red mud, ochre pebbles, soft blue fibrous crust
items.props_detail: A thin rim of blue fibrous residue around a vanished pool
items.lens_technique: shallow depth of field, macro lens
items.mood: Silent drying ground, the residue left exactly where the water stopped
items.narration_anchor: Fibras azules que el agua deja donde se seca.

items.subject: A creek channel running past a weathered boundary fence of the contaminated zone
items.action: Fibre-laden sediment continues past the old fence line into open country beyond
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction from the fence outward along the channel
items.setting: Edge of the Wittenoom contamination zone, sagging wire fence posts, red plain
items.color_palette: Red earth, rust-brown fence wire, grey silt, hints of blue, dusty sky
items.props_detail: A leaning rusted fence post with the channel flowing beneath its wire
items.mood: Boundary that holds nothing, quiet water slipping past, empty plain
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintiuno, una nota ambiental registró fibras en canales de arroyos fuera de la zona marcada como contaminada.

items.subject: The Fortescue River catchment stretching to the horizon
items.action: The river winds slowly away through the plain as the first light reaches it
items.gaze_interaction: Focal line follows the river into the far distance
items.setting: Fortescue River valley in the Pilbara, river gums, red ranges
items.color_palette: Red ochre ranges, silver river, olive gums, pale dawn blue
items.props_detail: A long ribbon of water reflecting the dawn sky, banks faintly grey
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.lighting: first dawn light under thin overcast
items.mood: Immense calm, slow time, a landscape that will carry this for centuries
items.narration_anchor: El mismo informe advirtió que, sin intervención, el aporte de asbesto a la cuenca del Fortescue puede seguir durante cientos de años.

items.subject: An elderly Banjima Aboriginal man around 70, thin and frail, seated with a middle-aged Latin American visitor in plain shirt
items.action: The two sit together on red earth beneath a river gum, talking
items.gaze_interaction: The elder gazes out over his country, the visitor turned toward him listening
items.setting: Banjima country near Wittenoom Gorge, red ranges behind, spinifex
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, warm golden light, olive gum leaves
items.props_detail: The shade of a lone river gum pooling over the two figures
items.mood: Long shadows, quiet conversation, two small figures in vast land
items.narration_anchor: Es tierra Banjima. En dos mil veintitrés, Marcos Orellana visitó Australia y se sentó con Maitland Parker, un anciano Banjima.

items.subject: An elderly Banjima Aboriginal man around 70, gaunt frame, sunken cheeks, grey beard, worn shirt hanging loose
items.action: He stands firm on his country, refusing to turn away from it
items.gaze_interaction: Face to the front, wet eyes lifted past camera toward the ranges, shoulders bowed yet planted
items.setting: Red rock slope above a creek bed in Banjima country near Wittenoom
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, warm gold, deep brown skin, faded cotton
items.props_detail: A handful of red earth held loosely at his side
items.lighting: low golden hour light, rim on his shoulders
items.mood: Breath heavy, frame thin from illness, feet rooted in red ground, warm fading light
items.narration_anchor: «Todavía lloro por mi territorio, pero eso está arraigado en mí; simplemente no puedo alejarme de él», dijo Parker.

items.subject: An empty folding camp chair beneath the river gum where the elder used to sit
items.action: Wind stirs red dust around the vacant chair
items.gaze_interaction: Focal point on the empty seat and a worn wide-brim hat resting on it
items.setting: Banjima country near Wittenoom Gorge, red plain and distant ranges
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, fading gold, dusty olive
items.props_detail: A worn wide-brim hat left on the empty chair
items.lighting: late golden hour fading to dusk
items.mood: Absence, long shadows, dust drifting, light going down
items.narration_anchor: Maitland Parker murió de mesotelioma en dos mil veinticuatro.

items.subject: Federal Court building in Perth, a few Banjima Aboriginal community members of mixed ages walking up its steps, seen from behind
items.action: The group climbs the courthouse steps to lodge the claim
items.gaze_interaction: Figures face the entrance, backs to camera, a younger woman glancing up at the facade
items.setting: Federal Court exterior in Perth, pale stone and glass, wide forecourt
items.color_palette: Pale stone, cool glass, warm skin tones, muted shirts, clear blue sky
items.props_detail: A bound folder of documents carried under one arm
items.mood: Small figures against a large civic facade, steady deliberate steps
items.narration_anchor: Dos años después, Gordon Legal presentó en nombre de BNTAC un proceso contra Australia Occidental en el Tribunal Federal.

items.subject: A permanent steel barricade cutting the road into the old town and gorge
items.action: Wind pushes red dust across the empty road beyond the barrier
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction past the barricade into the empty red land
items.setting: Sealed access road to former Wittenoom, red ranges and gorge mouth beyond
items.color_palette: Red earth, rust, faded white paint, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A weathered warning sign bolted to the barricade
items.mood: Nothing beyond the barrier but wind and red earth, utter stillness

text_in_image.location: on the sign bolted to the barricade

items.narration_anchor: Nadie ha empezado a limpiar. En los accesos al pueblo y desfiladero hay bloqueos.

items.subject: The abandoned Wittenoom town site seen from above, decaying remains among blue-grey tailings
items.action: Dust drifts over deserted roads and foundations as dawn breaks
items.gaze_interaction: Focal sweep across the whole sealed-off site toward the gorge
items.setting: Former Wittenoom, demolished lots, empty streets, red Hamersley ranges
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, weathered grey iron, hints of blue tailings, pale dawn sky
items.props_detail: A tailings-surfaced road running empty through the site
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.mood: Silent open land, no movement but dust, a suspended unanswered quiet
items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de un «grave problema de salud y seguri
